_readme: GEOEXTRA (Stage 10 Landmarks) — the 24 photos' credits. The photos are NOT in the repo; they wait in a folder outside it until Mom says to import them (the import plan is in the slice's report). Licences: public domain, CC0 or CC BY only (no share-alike), one credit each. 'credit' is what goes on the card's visuals entry.
